set.body:
Scope
Convert the validation verdict into a conservative public product decision.

Acceptance criteria
- A decision record applies predeclared criteria based on held-out log loss, calibration, information gain, null behaviour, robustness, interpretability, and runtime.
- Replay becomes the encoding-to-recall default only if real evidence supports it; otherwise it remains experimental.
- Transport remains available for symmetric comparisons.
- The API exposes an explicit engine choice, shared candidate probabilities and gaze_info_bits, and engine-specific nested diagnostics.
- Compatibility and migration policy for v1 objects/functions is documented and tested.
- Plots distinguish raw gaze, registered gaze, optimal alignment, genuine posterior quantities, and numerical ambiguity.
- Vignettes state bounded claims and reproduce both successful and failure/uncertain cases.
- Focused tests, full package tests, validation regeneration, documentation generation, and R CMD check pass.
- Final provenance names exact folds, configurations, artifacts, package version, and unresolved scientific limitations.
set.title: GW-8 Select the default and harden API, documentation, and release evidence
